enrichment.summary: HDFC Bank’s board approved a one-year reappointment of V. Srinivasa Rangan as Whole-time Director, designated Executive Director, effective 23 November 2026. RBI approval has been received; shareholder approval is still required. This extends an existing appointment.
enrichment.whyItMatters: The disclosure establishes continuity in an existing executive role and identifies the remaining shareholder-approval condition. His current remit includes HR, legal, group oversight, investment banking, information security, ethics, and fraud/vigilance.

citations.quote: 1 (one) year effective from November 23, 2026, at the extant remuneration, subject to approval of the shareholders of the Bank.
citations.title: HDFCBANK Change in Director(s) 2026-11-13

citations.quote: heads the Human Resources, Corporate Legal, Group Oversight & Secretarial, Investment Banking, Information Security Group, Ethics Function and Fraud & Vigilance functions of the Bank.
citations.title: HDFCBANK Change in Director(s) 2026-11-13

citations.quote: He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce from University of Delhi and is an Associate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
citations.title: HDFCBANK Change in Director(s) 2026-11-13

management.effectiveDate: 23 November 2026; one-year term, subject to shareholder approval
management.background: Previously Executive Director and Chief Financial Officer of HDFC Limited before its 1 July 2023 amalgamation with HDFC Bank. He is a commerce graduate of the University of Delhi and an Associate of ICAI, with housing-finance and real-estate experience. He currently oversees multiple corporate and control functions at the bank.

source.quote: Mr. Rangan was an Executive Director & Chief Financial Officer of HDFC Limited prior to its amalgamation with the Bank w.e.f. July 1, 2023
source.title: HDFCBANK Change in Director(s) 2026-11-13

enrichment.summary: V. N. Srivatsan assumed office as HDFC Bank’s Chief Compliance Officer on 6 November 2026 for a three-year term. The board had approved his appointment on 30 September 2026; this filing confirms he has joined and become senior management personnel.
enrichment.whyItMatters: The filing identifies the executive now responsible for the bank’s compliance function and provides relevant regulatory-inspection and banking experience to assess his professional background.

citations.quote: Mr. Srivatsan has assumed office as the Chief Compliance Officer of the Bank with effect from November 6, 2026.
citations.title: HDFCBANK Change in Management 2026-11-06

citations.quote: Term: 3 (three) years from the date of joining.
citations.title: HDFCBANK Change in Management 2026-11-06

citations.quote: Mr. V. N. Srivatsan has approximately 34 years of overall professional experience, including around 25 years in the BFSI sector and close to 10 years of direct experience in Compliance and Regulatory Inspection.
citations.title: HDFCBANK Change in Management 2026-11-06

citations.quote: He holds a Post Graduate degree in Business Administration from PSG College of Technology and a Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech) from Sri Venkateshwara University.

enrichment.summary: Anup Bagchi assumed charge as HDFC Bank’s Managing Director and CEO on 27 October 2026. Sashidhar Jagdishan’s tenure ended at close of business on 26 October 2026. The filing attributes the outgoing CEO’s departure to completion of tenure.
enrichment.whyItMatters: This is the effective executive-leadership handover. It establishes who holds responsibility from 27 October and distinguishes the predecessor’s completed tenure from a resignation.

citations.quote: Mr. Sashidhar Jagdishan has vacated the office as the MD & CEO of the Bank from the close of business hours on October 26, 2026 on account of completion of his tenure
citations.title: HDFCBANK General Updates 2026-10-27

citations.quote: Mr. Anup Bagchi has assumed charge as MD & CEO of the Bank effective today i.e. October 27, 2026.
citations.title: HDFCBANK General Updates 2026-10-27

citations.quote: have already been provided in the intimation dated October 1, 2026.
citations.title: HDFCBANK General Updates 2026-10-27

enrichment.summary: NTPC’s board appointed Diwakar Nath Misra, Additional Secretary in the Ministry of Power, as an Additional Director (Government Nominee Director), effective 23 October 2026. The term runs until his Ministry of Power tenure ends or further orders, whichever is earlier.
enrichment.whyItMatters: The appointment updates government representation on NTPC’s board. The disclosed power, finance and public-administration experience supplies context for the incoming nominee’s governance role.
